name: [UPD2] Rochas313 Experience
desc:
You return to your place. Everything is covered in fog.
The place you once built… is now rotting from within.
The trees whisper. The walls remember. The code is twisted.
You’re not alone here — and maybe… you never were.
This isn’t a game. It’s a warning.
The only question is: what was infected first — the place, or you?
